notes: Weathered wooden name board on two posts at Lima Sands, Essequibo coast (camera 7.2966, -58.5453). 'BIO-DIVERSITY' is in smaller letters stacked above 'PARK'; the board is faded and the photo is HDR-processed. An old boat in the foreground and a person standing in the background are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Dan Sloan
attribution: Photo: Dan Sloan, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sloth_Island_-_Barica,_Guyana_(23654276145).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Oval cast plaque with raised letters and peeling pale-green paint at Fort Kyk-Over-Al on the Essequibo River (no camera location; Commons categories Fort Kyk-Over-Al / Sloth Island - Barica). The lower parts of the curved bottom line are hidden by leaves; KYK, OVER and AL are readable but whether hyphens separate the words cannot be seen, so they are written with spaces. Strong mottled paint texture.

notes: White welcome board on the wall of the Anna Regina high bridge (camera 7.2626, -58.4806); 'Anna Regina' in brown script. A tiny 'Proudly sponsored by ...' line under it is unreadable and not transcribed. Distractors: the same 'Anna Regina' plate on the arch above, beer/detergent adverts and a small notice on the wall. HDR-processed. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
